SELECT j.job_id as jobId, j.comp_id as compId, u.company_name as comName, j.title, j.field, CASE WHEN j.exp_year IS NULL THEN '경력 무관' WHEN j.exp_year = '0' OR j.exp_year LIKE '%신입%' THEN '신입' ELSE '경력' END as expYear, j.edu, j.address, j.close_date as closeDate FROM JOB_POSTING j JOIN USER_COMPANY u ON j.comp_id = u.user_id
AND (j.exp_type = 'new' OR j.exp_year = '0')
AND j.exp_type = 'career'
AND (
j.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{item}, '%') OR j.field LIKE CONCAT('%', #{item}, '%')
)
AND j.edu = '학력무관'
AND (j.edu = #{eduType} OR j.edu = '학력무관')
ORDER BY j.job_id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '^[0-9\\s\\[\\],-]+', '')), ' ', 1) as city, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '^[0-9\\s\\[\\],-]+', '')), ' ', 2), ' ', -1) as district FROM JOB_POSTING WHERE post_status = 1 AND address IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.job_id, p.comp_id, c.company_name, p.title, p.field, p.task, p.emp_type, p.probation, CASE WHEN p.exp_year IS NULL THEN '경력 무관' WHEN p.exp_year = '0' OR p.exp_year LIKE '%신입%' THEN '신입·경력' ELSE p.exp_year END as exp_year, p.edu, p.salary, p.address, p.is_remote, p.mgr_name, p.mgr_phone, p.mgr_email, p.is_public, p.open_date, p.close_date, p.post_status, p.reg_date, p.post_check FROM job_posting p JOIN user_company c ON p.comp_id = c.user_id WHERE p.job_id = #{jobId}
